lines.en: Sade, I enjoy visiting the museum on rainy days. Would you consider joining me on Saturday morning?
lines.pt: Sade, eu gosto de visitar o museu em dias de chuva. Você consideraria me acompanhar no sábado de manhã?

lines.en: I would love that, Selma. My sister suggested going there last month, but we kept postponing the trip.
lines.pt: Eu adoraria, Selma. Minha irmã sugeriu irmos lá no mês passado, mas ficamos adiando o passeio.

lines.en: Then let us go early. I try to avoid arriving after ten, because the rooms are crowded and noisy.
lines.pt: Então vamos cedo. Eu evito chegar depois das dez, porque as salas ficam cheias e barulhentas.

lines.en: Perfect. Should I buy the tickets online? Otherwise we will lose time, and the queue gets long on Saturdays.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Devo comprar os ingressos on-line? Senão perdemos tempo, e a fila fica grande aos sábados.

lines.en: Yes, please. I have seen the modern art section twice, so I am considering visiting the new photography exhibition.
lines.pt: Sim, por favor. Já vi a seção de arte moderna duas vezes, então estou pensando em visitar a nova exposição de fotografia.

lines.en: That sounds interesting. Is it true that the photographs show the old neighborhoods of the city? I read something about it.
lines.pt: Parece interessante. É verdade que as fotos mostram os bairros antigos da cidade? Li algo sobre isso.

lines.en: Yes, they were taken in the fifties. My grandfather is in one of them, so I am very curious to see it.
lines.pt: Sim, foram tiradas nos anos cinquenta. Meu avô está em uma delas, então estou muito curioso para ver.

lines.en: Really? Then we must take a picture of you next to it. Although I am not sure photography is allowed inside.
lines.pt: Sério? Então precisamos tirar uma foto sua ao lado dela. Embora eu não tenha certeza se fotografar é permitido lá dentro.

lines.en: It depends on the room. I finished reading the museum rules yesterday, and flash photography is not allowed anywhere.
lines.pt: Depende da sala. Terminei de ler as regras do museu ontem, e fotografia com flash não é permitida em lugar nenhum.

lines.en: Then I will not use flash. Afterwards, we could have lunch in the cafe and talk about our favorite paintings.
lines.pt: Então não vou usar flash. Depois, podemos almoçar no café e conversar sobre nossas pinturas favoritas.

lines.en: Wonderful. See you at nine at the main entrance, and please do not be late this time!
lines.pt: Ótimo. Nos vemos às nove na entrada principal, e por favor não se atrase desta vez!

facts.label: Verbos com -ing
facts.sub: She suggested going. I avoid arriving late. I enjoy visiting museums. I am considering joining you.

facts.label: sugerir + -ing
facts.sub: Suggest é seguido de -ing: She suggested going to the museum. We suggested leaving early. Não use to depois de suggest.

facts.label: gostar de fazer
facts.sub: Enjoy pede -ing: I enjoy visiting museums. Do you enjoy walking in the city? Não diga enjoy to visit. Depois de enjoy, o segundo verbo sempre termina em -ing.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Suggest is followed by -ing in She suggested going.
We say I enjoy to visit museums.
Avoid + -ing means try not to do something.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Suggest is followed by -ing in She suggested going. → Verdadeiro (Suggest + -ing is the usual pattern.)
We say I enjoy to visit museums. → Falso (Enjoy is followed by -ing.)
Avoid + -ing means try not to do something. → Verdadeiro (I avoid arriving late.)

pages.title: A rainy day at the museum · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Friday evening in Chicago. Dirk looks at a poster of an exhibition. His friend Luisa sits next to him. They are planning the weekend. Last month, they postponed a visit. This time, they want to go early.

“Luisa, I enjoy visiting the museum on rainy days. Would you consider joining me on Saturday morning?” says Dirk. “I would love that, Dirk. My sister suggested going there last month, but we kept postponing the trip.” says Luisa. “Then let us go early. I try to avoid arriving after ten, because the rooms are crowded and noisy.” says Dirk.
